payload.feedback:
Revise. Most of this plan is accurate, and every file and line range you cite checks out. But the statements below are false at f90506b34ba2abd4fd6318e58a6aacb03a602333. Correct each one from the checkout, and keep the rest of the plan as it is.
1. There is no OPEN state, and no PLAN_APPROVED or CANCELLED state. T1 moves ROOM_CREATED to SCOPED, T5 moves PLAN_REVIEW to BUILDING, and T22 moves the room to CLOSED_ABANDONED (packages/contracts/src/states.ts and transitions.ts).
2. The scope of a lifecycle event is roomId, repo and paths (the Scope interface in packages/contracts/src/attribution.ts), not repository, baseSha and paths.
3. GatewayPlannerChannel does not journal identity_bound and writes nothing to the journal. PlannerLoop journals identity_bound after planner.attest returns.
4. The finished report does not carry raw PlanDoc text. Its result is either kind plan with the document the Gateway already parsed, or kind failed (PlannerResultWire in packages/gateway-protocol/src/planner.ts).
5. AgyPlannerExecutor writes no prompt or output evidence. Its evidence record holds commandId, executionId, startedAt, agySha256, initModel, conversationId, sent, endedAt, outcome, exitCode, signal and checkoutRemoved, plus closing diagnostics, and no text that agy or the model wrote.
6. There is no public.build_room_journal. The journal tables are command_journal_events and command_journal_chain_head.
7. founderApprovalRecorded and revisionFeedbackAttached do not exist. The T4 fact is feedbackAttached, and the T5 facts are planHash, expectedPlanHash and scopePathsCanonical (packages/control-plane/src/plan-decision.ts).
8. evaluatePhase4RunSet does not exist. The terms are checked by validatePhase4RunSet (packages/run-harness/src/phase4/run-set.ts) and the set by phase4SetStatus (run-sequence.ts).
9. There is no npm run custody:check. The scripts are npm run gate:custody-pin-check and npm run gate:custody-pin-selftest (package.json).
10. Nothing in packages/control-plane concerns occupancy. Do not say CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN guards occupancy; say what it guards only if you read the routes.
The plan is about 27,500 characters; keep it under 25,000. Before returning it, check every name and every claim about behaviour against the files you read, and remove any you did not see.

Revise. This is the final revision. You took all ten earlier corrections; keep them. But this plan is 42,818 characters and adds many new statements that are false at f90506b34ba2abd4fd6318e58a6aacb03a602333, several of them things your previous plan had right. Name far fewer things: describe the behaviour in plain words unless the README section needs the exact name and you read it in the checkout. Keep the whole plan under 20,000 characters. Correct these:
1. agy runs as sudo -n -u <planner user> -- <agy> with PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS: --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --model gemini-4-argon-high --effort high --mode plan --sandbox --print-timeout 900s. There is no chat subcommand, no --print and no --mode agent, and nothing in the code uses Landlock.
2. choosePlannerExecutor (planner-executor-factory.ts) enables the agy executor when BUILDROOM_PLANNER_EXECUTOR is agy and BUILDROOM_PLANNER_USER, BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY, BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY_SHA256 and BUILDROOM_PLANNER_CHECKOUTS are set. createPlannerExecutorFromEnv, BUILDROOM_AGY_PAT and pinnedAgySha256 do not exist.
3. The worker class is GatewayPlannerWorker, not PlannerWorker.
4. plannerCommandIdFor hashes the prefix build-room/planner-command/v1, not BRJ:planner-cmd:1.
5. A revision round carries revision with feedback and revisingPlanHash; priorPlanHash and revisionFeedback do not exist.
6. Every planner request carries requestId; attest also carries role and intended, and execute carries commandId, executionId and work, with no identity. Report payloads carry no commandId: attested carries identity; accepted, running and finished carry observed, not route.
7. The init event is the event named init, not system:init. The executor writes its evidence record with sent set to true before it writes the prompt, not after.
8. PLANNER_FAILURES are authorization_does_not_cover, authorization_indeterminate, attestation_failed, identity_mismatch, not_sent, route_mismatch, planner_reported_failure, plan_invalid, plan_outside_captured_scope, plan_refused, completion_not_covered and round_superseded. execution_failed, invalid_plandoc, scope_violation, credential_in_plan, planner_blocked, retry_budget_exhausted, transport_lost, missing_init_evidence and reconcile_inconclusive do not exist.
9. PlannerRecovery has one method, recoverRoom(roomId); there is no recover(). When the journal does not verify it returns a refusal and does not throw JournalIntegrityError, and nothing in the service calls it at startup; only tests do.
10. judgeRoundPlan does not check work_id.
11. In plan-decision.ts the function is cancelBinding, not checkCancelBinding. The request body holds only decision, planHash, feedback, eventId and attribution; there is no unconfirmed field, and a cancel while a command is pending goes through as an unconfirmed cancel by itself. active_command_requires_unconfirmed and invalid_state do not exist: a room with no planner command answers 409 founder_cancel_unavailable, and a transition the room state refuses answers 409 with outcome rejected and a code. Decision records hold no outcome or reasonCode.
12. POST planner-round checks the deployment id, that the dispatcher surface is registered and that no round is in flight. It does not compare the room repo or baseSha with PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN, which holds only actId, gatewayId, planner and seats.
13. GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal returns roomId, deploymentId, commands, decisions and journal (verified and headSeq, or a reason). There is no events or chainHead field.
14. Migration 0010 creates the trigger build_room_plans_append_only, which runs the function build_room_plans_immutable. It names no owner; do not say neondb_owner owns the table.
15. The executor evidence file is planner-evidence/<sha256(commandId)>.json under the Gateway directory. evidenceDir and <commandId>.json are wrong.
16. The harness writes attempts.json, run.lock, plan-<planHash>.json, <label>-<roomId>.record.json and <label>-<roomId>.record.sha256 in PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR. Attempt bundles, entry-verdict.json and set-status.json do not exist. createAttemptStore, runPhase4Attempt, preflightPhase4Attempt, createHttpPhase4Driver and main do not exist; the names are Phase4Runner, HttpPhase4Driver, evaluatePhase4LiveCheck and phase4CountedRunMain.
17. npm run phase4:counted-run takes no flags. It reads PHASE4_TERMS_FILE, PHASE4_TERMS_SHA256, PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, FOUNDEROS_PATH, PHASE4_EXECUTOR_CONFIRMED, CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN and PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN, and takes the control plane origin from the terms file. It does not use CONTROL_PLANE_URL or PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN.
18. These line numbers are wrong: requireRuntimeIdentity is at line 1001 of journal-store.ts, JOURNAL_APPEND_LOCK_KEY at line 151, parsePlanResponse at line 374 of agy-planner-executor.ts, the 403 governed_path_required refusal at line 237 of server.ts, and migrations 0006 and 0010 start at lines 1387 and 1875 of migrations.ts. Give a line number only for a line you read.
